title: NY円は157円台前半　日本の為替介入の反動でドル買い優勢
extracted_text: 1日のニューヨーク外国為替市場の円相場は午後5時現在、前日比46銭円安ドル高の1ドル＝157円04～14銭を付けた。ユーロは1ユーロ＝1・1716～26ドル、183円94銭～184円04銭。 日本政府、日銀が前日に為替介入に踏み切って円高ドル安が進んだ反動から、円売りドル買いの動きが優勢だった。（共同）
translated_text: On the New York foreign exchange market on Tuesday, the yen was at 157.04-14 yen per dollar at 5 p.m., down 0.46 yen from the previous day. The euro was at $1.1716-26 and 183.94-184.04 yen. Dollar buying dominated as a reaction to the Japanese government and Bank of Japan's forex intervention the previous day, which had pushed the yen higher against the dollar. (Kyodo)
title_en: Yen falls to mid-157 yen range in NY as dollar buying dominates after Japan's FX intervention
